mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT n.NOTI_NUM, n.SENDER_NUM, n.RECEIVER_NUM, n.TEAM_NUM, n.NOTI_TYPE, n.TITLE, n.CONTENT, n.REG_DATE, n.READ_STATUS, n.LINK, u.USER_NAME AS SENDER_NAME, t.TEAM_NAME AS TEAM_NAME FROM NOTIFICATION n JOIN USERS u ON n.SENDER_NUM = u.USER_NUM LEFT JOIN TEAM t ON n.TEAM_NUM = t.TEAM_NUM WHERE n.RECEIVER_NUM = #{receiver_num} ORDER BY n.REG_DATE DESC, n.NOTI_NUM DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 30
